step1_analysis.description: A master-slave D-flip-flop configured with inverted feedback to divide the input clock frequency by 2. It uses a CML topology with stacked differential pairs, cross-coupled latches, and clock steering pairs for high-speed operation.

Output Frequency.description: Frequency of the divided output signal, which should be exactly half of the input clock frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Tested at 2 GHz input clock to accommodate the L=0.5um channel length in the extracted netlist, resulting in a 1 GHz output.

Power Consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the divider circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a chosen bias of 0.7V for the tail current sources to ensure all stacked transistors remain in saturation.
Designed load resistors (2.5k) and tail current (121uA) to provide sufficient swing to fully switch the subsequent CML stages.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify divide-by-2 operation, measure output frequency, voltage swing, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM6 I_N Q_N N1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM14 I_N I_P N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM4 I_P I_N N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 I_P Q_P N1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM9 Q_N I_P N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM2 Q_N Q_P N4 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM11 Q_P Q_N N4 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM1 Q_P I_N N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM8 N1 CLK_P N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM7 N2 CLK_N N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM12 N3 CLK_N N6 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM5 N4 CLK_P N6 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM15 N5 LOW_VT N7 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM13 N7 BIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM16 N6 LOW_VT N8 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM10 N8 BIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Load resistors (required for CML operation)
R1 I_P VDD 2.5k
R2 I_N VDD 2.5k
R3 Q_P VDD 2.5k
R4 Q_N VDD 2.5k

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VLOW_VT LOW_VT 0 0.9

* Clock inputs (2 GHz, 1.1V Common Mode, 0.6Vpp diff swing)
VCLK_P CLK_P 0 DC 1.1 SINE(1.1 0.3 2G)
VCLK_N CLK_N 0 DC 1.1 SINE(1.1 -0.3 2G)

* Behavioral source for differential output
B1 diff_out 0 V=v(Q_P)-v(Q_N)

.control
  * Transient analysis
  tran 5p 10n
  
  * Measure power (average current)
  meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=5n to=10n
  
  * Measure output period and frequency
  meas tran out_period trig v(diff_out) val=0 rise=3 targ v(diff_out) val=0 rise=4
  
  * Measure output swing
  meas tran vmax max v(diff_out) from=5n to=10n
  meas tran vmin min v(diff_out) from=5n to=10n
  
  quit
.endc
.end
